question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Foremost
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"foremost"** means something that is most prominent in importance, position, or rank. (प्रमुख)
 
 
• **Example: **She is the foremost expert in the field of genetics.
 
 
 
• **"Unimportant"** refers to something that lacks significance or value; it is not essential or noteworthy. (महत्वहीन)
 
 
• **Example: **The details he provided were unimportant to the overall investigation.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'foremost'** is **'unimportant'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Disposed** (इच्छुक): Having a tendency or willingness to do something.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt disposed to help him despite their differences.
 
 
 
• **Forecast** (पूर्वानुमान): To predict or estimate a future event or trend.
 
 
• **Example:** The weather forecast predicts rain for tomorrow.
 
 
 
• **Premature** (अकाल): Occurring or done before the usual or proper time; too early.
 
 
• **Example:** His premature departure left the team in disarray.
